event: A creak and thud sound as a door closes.

sounding_object.description: A light blue, arched wooden front door with a black metal handle and a small, four-paned window. A floral wreath with green leaves and pink/purple flowers and Easter eggs is hanging on it. The door is set into a stone archway. Approximate size: standard door height (around 2 meters), width ~0.8-1 meter.

reference_object.description: The camera wearer, from whose perspective the scene is viewed.

facing_object.description: The direction the camera is pointing. At the time of the sound, it's generally towards the center of the living room where a woman is standing.

question: Imagine you are the camera wearer, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sound source: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
